assets.why: The September 9 V4 opened on the interview question and the twenty-second answer. That script is superseded entirely. V4_MG01_Introduction_Or_Defense.png has no place in the corrected script.
assets.trigger: Three times in five years, I stepped into a role that did not have a predecessor. Each time, the title was new to me. But the work underneath it was not completely new.

assets.why: The three-stop structure does not exist in any prior V4 asset.
assets.trigger: What changed was how I judged whether I was ready. I stopped waiting for an exact title match. I stopped proving myself with a task list. And I stopped treating every learning gap like evidence that I was not ready.

assets.why: New framing introduced by the corrected master.
assets.trigger: If you are looking at a role you have never held before, use three questions instead: What problem will I be trusted to solve? What can I already prove? What do I genuinely need to learn?

assets.why: V4_MG03_Order_Depends_On_The_Question.png tested a different idea. The comparison shape is reusable; the content is entirely new.
assets.trigger: A useful way to test this is to compare the old and new role without their titles.

assets.why: Judgment-over-activity is new to the corrected V4.
assets.trigger: For unfamiliar work, look for evidence of judgment.

assets.why: No prior V4 asset carried this.
assets.trigger: A credible readiness case is not, 'I can already do every part of this.' It is, 'Here is what I can carry, here is the proof, and here is what I still need to learn.'

assets.why: The readiness case replaces the prior twenty-second and ninety-second answer assets entirely.
assets.trigger: Take one role you have never held and write three lines.
